findings.commitment: Payout ledger connector will handle up to 40,000 payouts per day by the end of the first year

promise_quotes.quote: The payout ledger connector will handle up to 40,000 payouts per day by the end of the first year.

findings.reason: Elva promised 40,000 payouts/day by year end, but Singapore's catalogue cap is 25,000/day and the pricing note records no approved exception for the higher volume.

findings.commitment: Payout ledger connector will handle up to 40,000 payouts per day by the end of the first year

promise_quotes.quote: The payout ledger connector will handle up to 40,000 payouts per day by the end of the first year.

missing_phrases: by the end of the first year
findings.reason: The SOW only commits to 12,000 payouts/day at launch; the promised scale-up to 40,000/day by year one appears nowhere in the contract chain, so it is unenforceable.

findings.commitment: VASP counterparty data exchange will be generally available in Singapore by 31 March 2027

promise_quotes.quote: For payouts to exchange-hosted wallets, VASP counterparty data exchange will be generally available in Singapore by 31 March 2027.

note_quote.quote: No named exception approved for Harbour Bank

findings.reason: VASP counterparty data exchange is still on the roadmap and requires named approval, but no named approver has signed off for Harbour Bank, so Elva cannot commit to a 31 March 2027 GA date.

findings.commitment: VASP counterparty data exchange will be generally available in Singapore by 31 March 2027

promise_quotes.quote: For payouts to exchange-hosted wallets, VASP counterparty data exchange will be generally available in Singapore by 31 March 2027.

findings.reason: This VASP data exchange commitment and its 31 March 2027 date are not mentioned anywhere in the SOW or contract, leaving a material promise with no contractual backing.

findings.commitment: Real-time wallet screening on Polygon will be live from the 1 December launch

promise_quotes.quote: Every NUSD payout on Polygon will be screened in real time through Elva's analytics integration before release, from the 1 December launch.

findings.reason: The proposal ties Polygon real-time screening to the 1 December launch date, but the SOW's wallet-screening specification contains no launch date, so the timing commitment is not reflected in the contract chain.
